title: AdvAnchor: Enhancing Diffusion Model Unlearning with Adversarial Anchors
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (AdvAnchor) for erasing undesirable concepts from text-to-image diffusion models. While it evaluates safety categories like 'Hate' and 'Harassment' within the I2P dataset, its focus is on the mechanism of unlearning rather than benchmarking religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
